record.title: Prove complex planning and historical-evidence conformance
record.intent: Pressure-test orthogonal roadmap/epic membership and historical evidence against complex graph fixtures after the protocol checkpoint.
requirements: Cover overlapping planning indexes, immutable identity, imported closure evidence and contract revision without imposing ownership or fabricated planning lifecycle.
This is taskctl compatibility work using isolated specimens or fixtures. Operational adoption, copied-tool retirement and consumer integration remain tasks owned by each consumer repository.
Include native planning amendment, archival and scope-bound assessment history in the complex planning conformance proof after TASK.protocol.planning-history.
acceptance: Reproducible conformance cases preserve the causal graph, planning projections and evidence identities.
Preserve the recorded prerequisite gates; this task does not itself authorize consumer migration, protocol freeze or service implementation.
